title: Île aux Cerfs Catamaran Day
summary: Sail the east coast lagoon, snorkel over coral gardens and relax on Île aux Cerfs.
intro: A relaxed day on the turquoise east coast lagoon. We sail past mangroves and fishing villages, stop to snorkel over coral gardens, then spend the afternoon on the soft white sands of Île aux Cerfs.

itinerary.title: Hotel pick-up
itinerary.text: Air-conditioned transfer to Trou d'Eau Douce.

itinerary.title: Set sail
itinerary.text: Board the catamaran with coffee and fresh fruit.

itinerary.title: Snorkelling stop
itinerary.text: Swim over the coral gardens with your guide.

itinerary.title: Barbecue lunch
itinerary.text: Grilled fish, chicken and salads served on board.

itinerary.title: Free time on Île aux Cerfs
itinerary.text: Swim, sunbathe or try optional water sports.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.text: Sail back and transfer to your hotel.

meetingPoint: Hotel pick-up, or Trou d'Eau Douce jetty at 09:15

title: Tamarin Bay Dolphin Watching
summary: An early-morning boat trip to watch wild dolphins respectfully in Tamarin Bay.
intro: Wild spinner and bottlenose dolphins often rest in Tamarin Bay in the early morning. We watch them from the boat at a respectful distance, following local marine guidelines, then snorkel at a quiet reef nearby.

itinerary.title: Hotel pick-up
itinerary.text: Early start, when the bay is calmest.

itinerary.title: Dolphin watching
itinerary.text: Observe the dolphins from the boat — no chasing, no crowding.

itinerary.title: Reef snorkelling
itinerary.text: Swim at a sheltered reef with your guide.

itinerary.title: Breakfast on board
itinerary.text: Fresh fruit, pastries and coffee.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.text: Back to the jetty and your hotel.

included: Boat trip with skipper and guide
meetingPoint: Hotel pick-up, or Tamarin public beach at 07:00

title: Chamarel & Black River Gorges
summary: Waterfalls, the Seven Coloured Earth and the island's greatest viewpoints in one day.
intro: Discover the green heart of the island. Stand above Chamarel waterfall, walk among the striped dunes of the Seven Coloured Earth, and stop at viewpoints over Black River Gorges National Park.

itinerary.title: Hotel pick-up
itinerary.text: Drive up to the cool south-west plateau.

itinerary.title: Black River Gorges viewpoint
itinerary.text: Views over the national park and its endemic forest.

itinerary.title: Chamarel waterfall
itinerary.text: The island's highest single-drop waterfall.

itinerary.title: Seven Coloured Earth
itinerary.text: Walk around the famous multicoloured dunes.

itinerary.title: Lunch with a view
itinerary.text: Mauritian Creole lunch at a local table d'hôte.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.text: Back to your hotel.

title: Le Morne Sunrise Hike
summary: Climb the UNESCO-listed mountain at dawn for unforgettable lagoon views.
intro: Le Morne Brabant is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a powerful symbol of freedom in Mauritian history. With a local guide, climb its forested trail at dawn and watch the sun light up the lagoon below.

itinerary.title: Early pick-up
itinerary.text: Drive to the base of the mountain in the dark.

itinerary.title: Start the climb
itinerary.text: Forest trail, then a steeper rocky section with your guide.

itinerary.title: Sunrise at the viewpoint
itinerary.text: Views over the lagoon and the 'underwater waterfall'.

itinerary.title: Descent
itinerary.text: Back down at a comfortable pace.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.text: Breakfast stop, then back to your hotel.

meetingPoint: Hotel pick-up, or Le Morne trailhead at 05:40

title: Port Louis Market & Street Food
summary: Taste dholl puri, gateaux piments and more on a walk through the capital.
intro: Port Louis is where the island's cultures meet on a plate. Walk through the Central Market, Chinatown and the old streets with a local foodie, tasting the snacks Mauritians love.

itinerary.title: Meet in Port Louis
itinerary.text: Or hotel pick-up from the north and west.

itinerary.title: Central Market
itinerary.text: Spices, tropical fruit and the famous alouda.

itinerary.title: Street-food tastings
itinerary.text: Dholl puri, gateaux piments, samoussas and more.

itinerary.title: Chinatown and old Port Louis
itinerary.text: Stories of the island's history and people.

itinerary.title: Caudan Waterfront
itinerary.text: Finish by the harbour with a fresh juice.

meetingPoint: Port Louis Central Market, main gate

title: Wild South Coast & Tea Route
summary: Dramatic cliffs at Gris Gris, a tea factory visit and a tasting with a view.
intro: The south is the wildest side of Mauritius, with no reef to tame the ocean. See the waves crash at Gris Gris, visit a historic tea estate, and taste its teas on a terrace overlooking the coast.

itinerary.title: Hotel pick-up
itinerary.text: Drive through sugar cane fields to the south.

itinerary.title: Tea factory visit
itinerary.text: See how tea is grown and processed.

itinerary.title: Tea tasting
itinerary.text: Flavoured teas on a terrace with sea views.

itinerary.title: Seaside lunch
itinerary.text: Fresh seafood in Souillac.

itinerary.title: Gris Gris cliffs
itinerary.text: Walk the cliffs where the waves break on the rocks.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.text: Back to your hotel.
